data.summary: Capital Markets and Investment Banking professional with 13+ years of experience across Derivatives, Wealth Management, Corporate Actions, Reference Data, Trade Lifecycle Management and regulatory reporting. Currently working as an Associate Business Analyst with hands-on exposure to requirement gathering, stakeholder management, functional analysis, BRD/FRD documentation, Agile/Scrum, JIRA, UAT, reference-data change, regulatory reporting and process automation. projects.name: Reference Data Enhancement
projects.description:
Reference Data Enhancement
Identified a reference-data gap affecting derivative and corporate-action related securities; designed a process to detect missing ISINs during batch runs and route them for priority setup.
Worked with SWIFT MT564/MR568 inputs and reference-data teams to improve completeness of resultant/underlying securities across market events.
Asian Market Screening Enhancement
Supported system changes for local and global sanctions screening, including hold-and-review processing for potentially sanctioned individuals, entities and countries.
Vanilla DRIP Corporate Actions Automation
Supported development of a Python BOT/Macro to create and book up to 50 corporate-action events in one batch using SWIFT information, reducing repetitive manual work and error probability.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Avaloq | Associate Business Analyst  |  Pune  |  Sep 2024 – Present
Analyze and resolve Smart Client application issues using JIRA, Agile/Scrum, SQL/PL-SQL and dashboards for ticket triage, root-cause analysis and stakeholder management.
Collaborate with development teams on security transaction, reporting and regulatory-reporting changes, ensuring timely resolution through Scrum boards and structured delivery governance.
Support Basel III and MiFID II compliance for transaction reporting and client classifications, including security-trade processing, regulatory reporting, reference-data updates, SIT and UAT.
UBS | Security Specialist (Business Analysis)  |  Pune  |  Jun 2019 – Mar 2024
Elicited requirements from stakeholders and acted as the bridge between business and technology teams for risk and regulatory-reporting initiatives within the Wealth Management Middle Office.
Analyzed existing functionality and change requests, performed system analysis, documented SOP updates and supported implementation of business-driven enhancements.
Supervised the quality and completeness of corporate-action trades and collaborated with business users to identify change requirements and functional improvements.
Created BRD/FRD documentation, use cases and traceability matrices; coordinated UAT with onshore stakeholders and supported implementation of approved changes.
Partnered with developers to automate Equity DRIP processes, reducing manual effort, errors and human intervention.
Served as IT Coordinator between SMEs and technology teams, improving issue resolution and reducing BAU effort by approximately 30%.
Supported trade surveillance, risk/control reporting, reconciliation-break resolution, settlement queries and corporate-action processing with business and technology stakeholders.
EARLIER EXPERIENCE
Deutsche Bank Operations India | Process Supervisor  |  Pune  |  Sep 2013 – May 2019
Managed Fixed Income and Corporate Actions activities covering Novation, New and Unwind trades, product validation and event processing.
Reviewed and approved Fixed Income events, monitored regional/currency cut-off times and supported high-priority risk and event-management issues as SME.
Managed BANCS application queues, announcement processing, mailbox workflows, SLA adherence and risk-capture reports including payment failures, discrepancies and T+1 reporting.
Supported transition of the PIMCO novation trade-capture process from Bangalore to Pune in 2019.
eClerx Services Ltd | Financial Analyst  |  Pune  |  Jun 2010 – Sep 2013
Performed financial data mining, market-data updates and reporting using sources including Bloomberg, CREST, CUSIP, Telekurs and London IMS.
Updated market information and financial instruments across trader systems including NTPA, Fidessa and Asset Control/SAP.
Supported book maintenance, fund transfers, settlement and reconciliation processes across Fixed Income and FX activities.
Managed FX trade confirmation and settlement workflows using systems including FXall, MISYS, GTSS, CLS and TUMS.
